I: San Fransisco Nanban Day (Franban Day)

It is one of the railway events of the month. In most cases, it begins at 15th day from Thanks Giving Festival(1st day of the Railway Schedule). We can buy one of Nanban Trade Goods for 24 hours.

Railway Schedule: tinyurl.com/RailwayUWO (more detailed info at TAB 7: Franban)

How can I check the Trade Goods on Fran Ban Day?

can confirm the Franban Good though we are away from SF.

1. Chart San Francisco, Open Sea
2. Press "M" key in game
3. Wide Sea Zone: W Coast of North America
4. Specific Sea Area: San Fransisco, Open Sea
5. Click "Details" Button
6. San Fransisco > Trade Goods Information
7. Scroll Down the bar
8. Franban Good of Today will appear!
